answer_1.quote: Opinion-centric insight generation (OIG) assesses whether LLMs can mine high-level topics and insights from user opinions expressed in online content.
answer_1.outputs: structured (entity, feature, opinion) tuples and natural-language insight summaries

answer_2.quote: we employ both lexical and semantic automated evaluation metrics. For lexical evaluation, we adopt ROUGE-1... For semantic evaluation, we leverage BERTScore...

answer_3.quote: we also conduct reference-free assessments using an LLM-as-a judge

answer_4.quote: We assess the quality of the generated insight through a human evaluation conducted on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT)... ask three human judges per example to evaluate insights on a 1 to 5 scale across six criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Three human judges rate each insight on a 1-5 scale across six criteria (faithfulness, coverage, specificity, insightfulness, intent, fluency).
